title: Kusanagi Nene — Determined Director〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, umm... Great work during today's art festival, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, to be fair, all we had to do was screen our film, so we didn't do much compared to the other classes...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Don't sweat the details, Director!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Right...
Then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Everyone have a drink ready?
Alright, cheers...!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheers.
Cheers!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was really startled when everyone said they wanted to throw a wrap party, but I'm so relieved the teacher gave us the green light.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I was so nervous when they started screening our film. How about you?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Me too!
The last time I felt that nervous was during exams!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Everyone sounds like they're having fun.
This actually feels a lot like a school festival...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, Shiraishi...
Amisawa, Tachibana too? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We were just talking and decided that we really need to thank you for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank me? But I didn't do anything worth...

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: That's not true! Our film turned out as well as it did because you helped us stick through to the end as our director!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, shooting the last scene using drones was genius! Everyone watching got totally blown away...!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yeah, that felt really good!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. It did.
I even said, “Yes!” to myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But really, our film came together because of you guys. I mean, Amisawa, you did so much for us on-site.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And the costumes turned out great in the end because you came up with so many ideas for them, Tachibana.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And you, Shiraishi. Not only did you put on an incredible performance, you helped me get our class to have orderly discussions... I can't thank you enough for that.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So much for our plan. We came to thank her, but she ended up turning the tables on us.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Oh, Kusanagi! We should go grab some snacks before they're gone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay, let's go...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's so nice of them to want to come talk to me like this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I'm a little tired...
I might go relax over in a corner somewhere.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey. You taking a break...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Uh, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I haven't really talked to Shinonome alone like this much...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
I feel a little more comfortable around him now, but what are we supposed to talk about...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (W-Wait, I know...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you for agreeing to be the lead...
I really appreciate it since I know it must've felt really sudden.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm...? Oh, sure.
I mean, no one else seemed all that up for it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I know...
But you really pulled through during the final showdown...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think we were all able to keep going until the end because you didn't want to give up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're welcome... But you're still the one who got everyone across the finish line in the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember what you said about not wanting us to feel any regret? I have a feeling that the others would've been completely dispirited if it wasn't for that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, it gave me the motivation I needed...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, um... I think you did a good job.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting him to say something like that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I mean, there was no way I could've done this alone. Still...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If everyone thinks I was a good director... That makes me happy.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Akito! Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're taking a group photo, but it won't mean much if our director and hero aren't in it! So, you two, get over here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, alright... Be right there.
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: You're the director! Don't stand off to the side like that! You get to take center stage with the trophy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-Is it really okay for me to be in the middle...? I'm getting really anxious...)

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Okay! Ready, everyone?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Smile for the camera, Kusanagi!
Also, throw up a peace sign!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Huh? Like this...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You do something too, Akito!
Pose like the Wandering Cook for us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not a chance.
